entries.body: Had no idea what I was doing.
My first ever moot. Little did I know it would form such a huge part of my uni life.

entries.role: First external moot (limped into the semi-finals)
entries.body: My first ever external moot and is still one of the most eye-opening experiences to date.
Thus begins my tumultuous relationship with the AGLC.

entries.org: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner
entries.body: Very grateful for the opportunity on the Significant Decisions team to draft Freedom of Information merits review decisions.
Added the phrase 'fiduciary duty' to my list of PTSD triggers.
Had the amazing opportunity to moot before Martin Scott KC (CIArb Board Member; Chair of the International Arbitration Committee at the Victorian Bar) and Matthew Secomb (Vice-Chair of the ICC)
Do not force me to argue that the payor's subjective intention does not matter in a defence of good consideration ever again.
Loved the UNSW Law Journal and the AGLC a bit too much, so became an Issue Editor. Issue forthcoming in April 2027.
Gave me strong opinions on the Woolwich principle.

entries.org: Sir Harry Gibbs Constitutional Law Moot
entries.body: Single-handedly liable for my interest in Constitutional Law. Had the amazing opportunity to moot in the High Court of Australia before the Hon Justice Beech-Jones and Andrew Buckland KC.

entries.org: Willem C Vis International Commercial Arbitration Moot
entries.body: For the first time in my life I tasted death, and death tasted bitter, for death is birth, is fear and dread of some terrible renewal.
